title: Introduction to Theology
description: What theology is and how it is done. Students learn the sources of theology (Scripture, tradition, reason, experience), the disciplines of biblical, historical, systematic and practical theology, the role of creeds and confessions, and a first overview of the major Christian doctrines. The course introduces the great theological traditions (Patristic, Catholic, Orthodox, Lutheran, Reformed, Anabaptist, Wesleyan, Pentecostal) and models how to weigh disputed questions charitably within the boundaries of the Nicene and Apostles' Creeds.

quiz_bank.question: Describe the four main theological disciplines and how they relate.
quiz_bank.answer_key: Biblical theology (the theology of Scripture in its historical unfolding), historical theology (how the church has understood doctrine), systematic theology (organizing doctrine topically into a coherent whole), and practical theology (applying doctrine to ministry, worship, preaching, care) - each feeds the others.
